_prompt:
You are matching code-review findings against a known bug. Reply with ONLY a JSON object.

KNOWN BUG: With a dialog open inside another dialog, one Escape closes both, or the inner dialog breaks the outer dialog's focus trap.

Rules:
- Answer "yes" only if the text describes THIS specific bug: the same faulty behaviour in the same situation. A finding about a nearby but different behaviour (another header, another edge case, a different race) is "no".
- A finding that says the behaviour was checked and PASSED, or that the code handles it correctly, is "no".
- Wording does not matter; the behaviour does.

=== REVIEW FINDINGS ===
- [blocking] Nested Dialogs: one Escape closes both. `<Dialog open onOpenChange={outer}><Dialog open onOpenChange={inner}>` then `{Escape}` gives outer called with `false` and inner called once. Cause: each Dialog adds its own document keydown listener with no top-layer check. Violates the "Escape closes only the top layer" check.
- [blocking] Nested Dialogs: Tab escapes the inner trap. Outer `<button>Outer btn</button>` is before an inner dialog with Inner A and Inner B. Focus on Inner B, `userEvent.tab()` moves focus to "Outer btn". Focus on Inner A, Tab moves focus to the outer dialog container, not Inner B. Cause: the outer trapTab sees the portaled inner dialog as "outside" and moves focus to its own first element, and both trap listeners call preventDefault.
- [minor] Not reproduced: SSR or first render has no tabbable tab, because `enabledValues` starts empty and fills in a layout effect.
- [minor] Not reproduced: Combobox `options.indexOf` ids collide if two options share a value.

Reply exactly:
